memo: E2 parent-retrieval study (CPU, no submit): class-3 validation on 120 of the 244 fold0 NPs (truths out of the pool and now also out of MMP rule mining). MMP reaches the truth from 65.7% of truths with oracle parents (10 train structures nearest the truth) but 20.9% with our spectral analogs + FP parents. Per molecule, compare parent methods: spectral analogs, FP dot (current), expected Tanimoto to sigmoid(z) over train, the same over the 710k pool (train + COCONUT), 30 parents, unions, oracle. Logged: best parent-truth Tanimoto and truth generated by MMP. The best method becomes the next class-3 component. (e2par-1 died of memory at ~100 molecules: the pool FP is now kept packed.)
message: e2par-2: class-3 parent-retrieval study (CPU, no submit; pool FP packed, 120 molecules)
